name: small-feature-default
description: Default OOL scope: a small feature on a development branch. Authorizes read + file edits + local commits + push to development + bounded agent dispatch; hard-halts-and-pages on any RED-tier or governance-surface op.

authorized_operations.note: push to dev/feature/fix/improve only; protected is the push-gate's domain
short agents only, <=80 tool calls each; window total capped by limits.max_tool_calls and fan-out by limits.max_agent_fanout
